units.source_text: 叔叔说，若是我坚持的话，推迟到我毕业前结婚也可以。

en.t: My uncle said that if I insisted, it would also be all right to postpone the marriage until before my graduation.

units.source_text: 他还说：俗话说‘善宜从速’，可以的话，趁现在先喝了交杯酒。

en.t: He also said that, as the saying goes, good things should be done quickly, so if possible we should at least exchange the wedding cups now.

units.source_text: 堂妹并非我心仪的女子，无所谓早办还是晚办，我再次拒绝了。

en.t: My cousin was not the woman I wanted, so whether it was done sooner or later made no difference to me, and I refused again.

units.source_text: 叔叔满脸不悦，堂妹也哭了。

en.t: My uncle looked thoroughly displeased, and my cousin cried too.

units.source_text: 她并不是因为我不同意结婚才伤心的，而是因为一个女人遭到男方拒绝，很丢面子。

en.t: She was not sad because I would not agree to the marriage, but because it was humiliating for a woman to be rejected by the man.

units.source_text: 我很明白，正如我不爱堂妹一样，堂妹也不爱我。

en.t: I understood very well that just as I did not love my cousin, she did not love me either.
I went back to Tokyo again.
